target.title: fix(clawrouter): sanitize attribution headers to ByteString
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where ClawRouter automatic agent/session attribution headers could include emoji or CJK characters. Fetch/`Headers` requires ByteString values, so Unicode ids throw `TypeError` before the model request is sent. A naive `_` replacement also collapsed distinct Unicode ids onto the same attribution value.

## Why This Change Was Made

`sanitizeAttributionValue` now keeps printable ASCII ids unchanged, and for rewritten values replaces non-printable ASCII with `_` plus a bounded `~sha256` suffix (same collision strategy as request-id sanitization). Control-character rejection, trim/empty handling, and explicit operator headers are unchanged.

## User Impact

**Before:** Unicode `agentId`/`sessionId` attribution could crash request construction with a ByteString `TypeError`, or distinct Unicode ids could collapse to identical headers after `_` replacement.
**After:** Automatic attribution headers are always printable ASCII and remain distinguishable after sanitization; CR/LF values are still omitted; length cap remains 256.

## Evidence

Branch: `codex/clawrouter-attribution-bytestring` | Base: `upstream/main` | Head: `133b6c10` | Node: v24.18.0 — Windows

### Regression tests

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clawrouter/index.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > sanitizes Unicode agent and session attribution to printable ASCII ByteString
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > keeps distinct Unicode agent ids distinct after ByteString sanitize
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > omits unsafe attribution header values
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > attaches bounded attribution without overriding configured metadata

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  11 passed (11)
```

- Unicode agent/session ids become printable ASCII with hash suffix when rewritten.
- Distinct emoji agent ids (`agent-😀` vs `agent-🚀`) remain distinct after sanitization.
- Sanitized headers construct with `new Headers(...)` without throwing.

### Diff summary

```text
extensions/clawrouter/stream.ts       | hash-suffixed ByteString sanitize for attribution
extensions/clawrouter/index.test.ts   | Unicode + collision + Headers construction regression
```

What was not tested: Live ClawRouter upstream acceptance/display of sanitized ids; explicit operator-supplied headers remain unsanitized by design.

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** ClawRouter automatic agent/session attribution headers are sanitized to printable ASCII ByteString without collapsing distinct Unicode ids; `Headers` construction no longer throws on emoji/CJK ids.
**Environment tested:** Windows, Node v24.18.0, worktree `codex/clawrouter-attribution-bytestring` at `133b6c10`; production `wrapClawRouterProviderStream` imported from source via `node --import tsx`.
**Steps run after the patch:**
1. Call production `wrapClawRouterProviderStream` twice with distinct emoji/CJK `agentId`/`sessionId` pairs.
2. Assert sanitized headers are distinct and construct with `new Headers(...)` without throwing.
3. Run focused vitest for Unicode + collision regression.
**Evidence after fix:**

```text
{
  "agentA": "agent-_~180a15e10004d245",
  "agentB": "agent-_~efe13e6d41b8efd3",
  "sessionA": "session-__~725bee23587f52ef",
  "sessionB": "session-___~045a79497d6607c7",
  "agentsDistinct": true,
  "sessionsDistinct": true,
  "headersOk": true
}
```

**Observed result:** Distinct Unicode agent/session ids produce distinct printable ASCII attribution headers; `new Headers(...)` succeeds on the sanitized header maps.
**Not tested:** Live ClawRouter upstream request acceptance or server-side display of sanitized ids; operator-supplied explicit headers remain unsanitized by design.
